newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai show elephant tramples Australian tourist.
newsitem.headline: Thai show elephant tramples Australian tourist.

text.p: An elephant performing in a popular elephant show troupe in northern Thailand crushed an Australian tourist to death on Tuesday, police said.
William Park, 57, was found dead near the Mae Rim Elephant Show in Chiang Mai province, about 750 km (450 miles) north of Bangkok, police said. Park's hometown was not available.
The elephant trainer told police he had chained the elephant in a rest area after the show and went out for lunch. He rushed back after hearing cries for help, and found Park already dead.
Witnesses told police Park went to feed the elephant with bananas when it grabbed him with its trunk, threw him on the ground and crushed him.
The Mae Rim Elephant Show is one of the most popular tourist spots in Chiang Mai. About 60 elephants dance, pull logs and kick soccer balls in three daily performances.
